The attacker established C2 communication with external IP 91.219.236.174 and successfully harvested credentials for two service accounts: svc-backup and svc-sql-prod. Immediate containment actions included blocking the C2 IP at the firewall, resetting both compromised service account credentials, and performing a full endpoint scan and hardening on the affected host (10.0.5.42). UEBA analysis showed low risk for svc-backup, indicating no anomalous usage post-theft. Asset record M2-5202 (decommissioned host) was reconciled with external reference 203.0.113.42.
